en: A color postcard showing a Baroque-style palace with a dark blue mansard roof, multiple chimneys and dormer windows, and a central portico with tall columns. The building is two stories high, painted in warm yellow and cream tones. In front of the palace is a formal garden with curved flowerbeds full of colorful flowers and neatly maintained lawns and paths. A few people are walking and standing on the terrace and in the garden. Hills covered with trees rise in the background under a clear blue sky. No visible printed text appears on the image side.
